title: 第124章 这一刀，会很帅！

content_zh: 一众大臣也都僵硬着脑袋抬头看向炎文帝，陛下，你是认真的吗？　　这就是你的解决方法？　　我们等着你放大招呢，你就给我们放这个？　　唐逸是文采风流不假，但他不会武功，用他那三寸不烂之舌舔死龙斩吗？　　众人瞬间就无语了，陛下这么不靠谱，现在后悔还来得及吗？　　孔诗岚，杜凌菲，萧岚三大美女这时也都瞪大美眸，有点难以置信，陛下不是很看重这家伙吗？怎么让这家伙去送死？　　唐敬看了一眼唐逸，目光复杂，他也不认为唐逸能解决这件事啊！　　那是暗京楼，恶名昭彰的暗京楼。　　他们连皇帝都敢杀，会在意一个小小的唐逸吗？　　唯独颜霜玉和姜云娜眼睛亮了起来，好，好啊，去吧，去送死吧！　　她们巴不得唐逸死无葬身之地！　　就连龙斩这时候也是怔住了，他想过炎文帝无数种破局的方法，就是没想过他会用唐逸，资料显示这家伙可一点武功都不会。　　他解决？一剑杀之！　　“陛下，你搞错了吧？”唐逸回过神，抬头看向炎文帝，有些咬牙切齿。　　我是有了准备，但我的准备只能暗中完成，不适合正面刚。　　你这直接将我顶到前面去了啊！　　我只是个小百户，不是你的大将军。　　然而，炎文帝走下来，抬手拍着他的肩膀，一副对他很有信心的样子。　　“怕什么？小子，你神功已成，该是建功立业的时候了。”　　“杀这百十个暗京楼蝼蚁，还不是一刀的事。”　　唐逸：“？”　　唐逸人当场都傻了，神功你大爷！你玩儿我呢？　　老子会个鬼的神功，全都是你胡诌的好吗？　　现在让我去施展假的神功？简直瞎搞啊！　　唰唰……　　而这时，前方的锦衣卫也都齐齐退开，让出了一条小道。　　小道直达桥头，一头站着的是龙斩，一头站着的是唐逸。　　气氛都到这了，他还能怎么办？赖着不上吗？　　“算你狠！”唐逸恶狠狠道。　　果然，知父莫若子，萧棣说的都是真的，他爹真是个十足十的坑货。　　“别逞强，上去想怎么玩就怎么玩，捅破天了朕给你补上。”　　炎文帝在唐逸耳边，低声说了一句。　　他是要这家伙闹大点，这样他能浑水摸鱼，譬如今日沈园诗会和决战暗京楼，不就给他创造了很多收拾丞相一党的机会？　　但是，不能真让这家伙遇到危险了。　　唐逸睨着炎文帝，这可是你说的，别后悔。　　炎文帝看着他的目光，莫名有些心虚，呃，这家伙不会真的闹得太大吧？　　额，应该不会，他就是个不会武功的小百户，就算本事再大，还能逆天了？　　而在他疑惑间，唐逸给萧棣打了个眼色，便转身向桥上走去。　　手按着绣春刀，一个人从数百人中走出，昂首挺胸上了桥，颇有一种壮士一去兮不复还的壮烈感。　　“呵，有意思，真有意思……”　　龙斩看着走过来的唐逸，拍着手笑道：“小诗仙，你难道看不出来，炎文帝是故意让你上来送死的吗？”　　“嗯？不对，他好像是对你挺有信心的，那就有意思了。”　　“咳咳……我很想知道，他的信心来自何处？”　　唐逸抬头看向龙斩，嘴角微微颤了颤，不，你错了，他不是对我有信心，他是对自己有信心。　　他让我上来，只是让我熬点资历而已。　　今日我站在这里迎战暗京楼，这是有目共睹的事实，将来他要给我封赏什么的也就名正言顺。　　只是……老子需要他来熬资历吗？老子一个穿越者，还需要用这种方式镀金？　　扯淡呢！　　“废话真多！”　　唐逸拇指一推，手中绣春刀出鞘半寸。　　他盯着龙斩，淡漠道：“放下武器投降，否则，杀无赦！”　　听到这话，全场瞬间一片死寂。　　所有人都震惊盯着唐逸，特别是那群大臣，差点当场就骂娘了。　　你大爷哦！陛下让你去是让你解决问题的，不是去激化问题的。　　现在人家人多高手多，要杀这里所有人，也不过是几个回合的事啊！　　你想死自己抹脖子去，别连累我们啊！　　宁川和苏狂等人也都无语了，陛下不是很看重这家伙吗？看重他什么啊？　　看重他看不清局面吗？　　我们处于劣势啊大哥，你就不会拖延一下时间吗？　　就连炎文帝，这时笑容也是微僵。　　你还真不客气啊，朕让你随便玩，你还真随便的。　　龙斩手一顿，差点以为自己听错了，这家伙竟然敢这么狂？　　“你……说什么？！”龙斩眼睛微眯，眼中有冷光。　　“怎么？听不懂人话？”　　唐逸抬起手中的绣春刀，一寸寸将刀拔出：“我说，放下武器投降，否则，一刀杀你们全部。”　　“现在，可听清了。”　　闻言，全场再度陷入死寂。　　这时候所有人看向唐逸的目光，已经像是在看个白痴了。　　就连炎文帝，也都抬手扶额，一副朕不认识他的样子。　　你知道在你眼前的是什么人吗？　　全是暗京楼的高手啊！　　随便一个出来都能以一敌百，就算是当世大宗师在此，也不敢说一剑灭全场。　　你一个不会武功的家伙，你却敢？！　　“呵，哈哈……”　　龙斩都给气笑了。　　他指着唐逸，冲着身后暗京楼众人道：“听到了吗？在我面前的不仅仅是小诗仙，还是剑仙呢！”　　“他，要一剑灭我们全部呢。”　　话落，龙斩转身手指扫过身后暗京楼的高手：“全都不要动，让小诗仙砍一刀。”　　“那可是大炎皇帝最看重的小诗仙，这个面子我们得给。”　　说完，他回头看向唐逸，手帕擦了擦嘴角。　　“来，出刀吧，砍死我们！”　　这些轮到唐逸愣住了，靠，你们居然还有这要求？　　那这要求必须满足啊！　　“罢了，良言难劝该死鬼，既然你们有这要求，我满足。”　　唐逸手中绣春刀已然出鞘，他随手将刀鞘丢下，单手高高抬起绣春刀。　　长刀在阳光下寒光闪烁！　　“这一刀，是我毕生所学最强的一刀，会很帅。”　　“你们，能死在这一刀之下，是你们的荣幸。”　　唐逸淡漠开口，背在身后的手却猛地攥成拳，给远处的萧棣打信号。　　点火！！！　　而看着这一幕，群臣都看向炎文帝，脸黑如锅底。　　所以，陛下你是让他上去丢人现眼的？　　炎文帝面色也有些尴尬，心底也有些后悔了，这家伙难道文采和谋略不成正比吗？怎么上台之后……感觉有点憨啊！　　朕说你神功大成，那是让你去忽悠人的。　　结果，你这一副神功大成的架势算怎么回事？！
content_en: All the ministers also looked up at Emperor Yanwen with their heads stiffened, "Your Majesty, are you serious?"​This is your solution?We are waiting for you to use your big move, so why don't you just show us this?It’s true that Tang Yi is talented in literature, but he doesn’t know martial arts. How can he lick Long Zhan to death with his impeccable tongue?Everyone was speechless for a moment. Your Majesty is so unreliable, is it too late to regret it now?The three beauties Kong Shilan, Du Lingfei, and Xiao Lan also opened their beautiful eyes at this time, a little unbelievable. Doesn't His Majesty value this guy very much?Why let this guy die?Tang Jing glanced at Tang Yi with complicated eyes. He didn't think Tang Yi could solve this matter!That is the Anjing Tower, the infamous Anjing Tower.They dared to kill even the emperor, would they care about a little Tang Yi?Only Yan Shuangyu and Jiang Yunna's eyes lit up, "Okay, okay, go ahead, go die!"They wished Tang Yi would die without a burial place!Even Long Zhan was stunned at this time. He had thought of countless ways for Emperor Yan Wen to break the situation, but he never thought that he would use Tang Yi. The data showed that this guy didn't know any martial arts.He solves it?Kill him with one sword!"Your Majesty, are you mistaken?" Tang Yi came back to his senses and looked up at Emperor Yanwen, gritting his teeth.I am prepared, but my preparation can only be completed in secret, not suitable for confrontation.You just pushed me forward!I am just a small householder, not your general.However, Emperor Yanwen came down and patted his shoulder, looking very confident in him."What are you afraid of? Boy, you have accomplished your magic, it's time to make a contribution." "Killing these hundreds of Anjing Tower ants is not just a matter of one blow." Tang Yi: "?" Tang Yi was dumbfounded on the spot, you are the master of magic!Are you playing with me?"I know some magical skills, but they are all your fault, okay?"Now you want me to perform fake magic?What a fool!Swish, swish... At this moment, the Jin Yiwei in front also all retreated, making way for a small path.The path leads directly to the bridge. Standing at one end is Long Zhan and at the other is Tang Yi.The atmosphere has reached this point, what else can he do?Can't you rely on it?"You're cruel!" Tang Yi said fiercely.As expected, everything Xiao Di said was true, his father was really a swindler."Don't be brave, go up and play whatever you want. If you break the sky, I will make it up for you." Emperor Yan Wen whispered in Tang Yi's ear.He wants this guy to make more trouble so that he can fish in troubled waters. For example, today's Shen Yuan Poetry Recital and the decisive battle at Anjing Tower have created many opportunities for him to clean up the Prime Minister's party?However, we can't really let this guy be in danger.Tang Yi looked at Emperor Yanwen, "This is what you said, don't regret it."Emperor Yan Wen looked at him, feeling a little guilty for no reason, eh, this guy wouldn't really make too much of a fuss, right?Well, probably not. He is just a humble guy who doesn’t know martial arts. No matter how powerful he is, he can still defy the heavens?While he was doubting, Tang Yi winked at Xiao Di, then turned and walked towards the bridge.Holding the embroidered spring knife in his hand, a man walked out from hundreds of people and walked onto the bridge with his head held high, giving him a sense of heroism as if a hero had gone and never returned."Oh, interesting, really interesting..." Long Zhan looked at Tang Yi who was walking over, clapped his hands and said with a smile: "Xiao Shixian, can't you see that Emperor Yan Wen deliberately asked you to come up and die?" "Huh? No, he seems to be kind to you.If you have confidence, that's interesting.""Ahem... I want to know where his confidence comes from?" Tang Yi looked up at Long Zhan, his mouth trembled slightly, no, you are wrong, he does not have confidence in me, he has confidence in himself.He asked me to come up just to get some experience.Today I stand here to face An Jinglou. This is a fact that is obvious to all. In the future, it will be justifiable for him to give me a reward or something."It's just...do I need him to pass the qualifications?"I am a time traveler, why do I still need to use gold plating in this way?What nonsense!"So much nonsense!" Tang Yi pushed with his thumb and unsheathed the embroidered spring knife half an inch.He stared at Long Zhan and said indifferently: "Put down your weapons and surrender, otherwise, you will be killed without mercy!" Upon hearing this, the whole place fell into dead silence.Everyone stared at Tang Yi in shock, especially the ministers, who almost cursed her on the spot.Your uncle!Your Majesty asked you to go to solve the problem, not to intensify it.Nowadays, there are so many masters and experts, it only takes a few rounds to kill everyone here!If you want to die, go ahead and wipe your neck, don't hurt us!Ning Chuan, Su Kuang and others were also speechless. Doesn’t His Majesty value this guy very much?What do you value about him?Do you care that he can't see the situation clearly?We are at a disadvantage, brother, won’t you delay it for a while?Even Emperor Yanwen’s smile froze slightly at this time.You are so rude, I let you play as you please, you are so casual.Long slashed his hands, almost thinking that he heard wrongly. How dare this guy be so crazy?"What...what did you say?!" Long Zhan narrowed his eyes slightly, with a cold light in his eyes."What? Can't you understand people?" Tang Yi raised the Xiuchun knife in his hand and pulled it out inch by inch: "I said, put down your weapons and surrender, otherwise, I will kill you all with one knife." "Now, you can hear me clearly." Hearing this, the whole place fell into dead silence again.At this time, everyone looked at Tang Yi as if they were looking at an idiot.Even Emperor Yanwen raised his hand to his forehead, as if I didn't recognize him.Do you know who is in front of you?They are all masters of Anjing Tower!Anyone who comes out can defeat one against a hundred. Even if the great master of the world is here, he dare not say that he can wipe out the entire crowd with one sword.You're a guy who doesn't know martial arts, but you dare?!"Haha, haha..." Long Zhan laughed angrily.He pointed at Tang Yi and said to the people in the Anjing Tower behind him: "Did you hear that? The person in front of me is not just the Little Poet Immortal, but also the Sword Immortal!" "He wants to kill us all with one sword." After saying that, Long Zhan turned around and swept his fingers across the masters in the Anjing Tower behind him: "Don't move any of them and let the Little Poet Immortal chop him." "That's the Little Poet Immortal that Emperor Dayan values ​​the most. This is our honor.
title_en: Chapter 124 This sword will be very handsome!
